general.evidence: No labelled evaluation exists for the mixed general profile. The shared spectral thresholding was stress-tested on OSCD, whose labels cover urban change only; that does not validate agriculture, deforestation or water labels.

agriculture.evidence: No labelled agriculture dataset has been scored. Single-pair NDVI/NDMI differences cannot separate harvest, irrigation or seasonal phenology from crop damage.

deforestation.evidence: No labelled forest-loss dataset has been scored. The profile is a transparent NBR/NDVI rule with a minimum mapping unit, not a validated forest-monitoring product.

builtup.status: quantitatively benchmarked on OSCD (urban change only, pooled F1 about 0.12)
builtup.evidence: The underlying spectral thresholding was scored on the official OSCD test split for urban change only. Source of record: benchmarks/results/oscd_results_v2.json and .md in this repository; the aggregate percentile configuration reached pooled F1 0.1176 (precision 0.2419, recall 0.0777). The added NDBI/BSI cues and MMU are not separately validated.

roads.evidence: No road labels have been scored. Roads narrower than about 20 m are mostly sub-pixel at 10 m Sentinel-2 resolution, so this profile does not claim road detection; OSM is context only.
